summary.intent: Complete Phase 20 (Vault Migration) gap closure by removing dead migration code, then resolve all PR review comments from automated reviewers (CodeRabbit, Copilot).
summary.outcome: Phase 20 fully completed with 9/9 verification truths passing and GAP-01 resolved. All 13 PR review threads resolved across 4 review rounds, with 6 real fixes implemented and pushed.

repo: Phase 20 vault migration made the server fully zero-knowledge: DB columns (encrypted_root_folder_key, encrypted_root_ipns_private_key, migrated_at) dropped, POST /vault/migrate endpoint removed, all crypto material now exclusively in IPFS v2 blobs

The web client correctly publishes the v2 blob to IPFS before calling POST /vault/init; the desktop Rust client had the order reversed (registered with API first, then uploaded to IPFS) — a critical atomicity bug
SDK E2E test harness (tests/sdk-e2e/src/fixtures/test-harness.ts) still sent old crypto fields on vault init after the DTO was simplified — NestJS whitelist validation rejected the extra properties
VaultExportDto was simplified in sync with the entity — the test assertion for encryptedRootFolderKey was correctly removed
recovery.html contains a standalone inline implementation of deserializeVaultBlobV2 that is separate from the packages/core blob.ts implementation and must be kept in sync manually
rootIpnsName in useAuth.ts is always HKDF-derived and therefore always identical to the stored value — CodeRabbit flagged this twice across two review rounds

code.finding: Zero-length key_len rejection added in deserializeVaultBlobV2; matching check also needed in serializeVaultBlobV2 (added in second Copilot review round)
Rust serialize and deserialize both needed zero-length key_len rejection to mirror TypeScript behavior; test_zero_length_key updated to expect errors
Critical ordering bug: /vault/init API call was before IPFS upload and IPNS publish. Must be after successful IPFS/IPNS operations to avoid orphaned backend vault rows with no blob
All fetch() calls in IPNS resolution and IPFS fetch functions needed AbortController timeout wrapper (fetchWithTimeout helper added, 15s/30s)
rootIpnsName flowed into innerHTML unsanitized; format validation (^k[0-9a-z]{20,}$) and escapeHtml helper added; encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey handling made optional
encryptVaultKeys import and crypto fields (encryptedRootFolderKey, encryptedRootIpnsPrivateKey) removed from vault init request body after DTO simplification
GET /vault assertions for crypto fields and GET /vault/export assertion for encryptedRootFolderKey removed to match simplified DTOs

workflow: GSD gap closure mode (--gaps-only) skips research and reads VERIFICATION.md directly to scope plans to only unresolved gaps
Planner agents commit plans themselves — the orchestrator should check git log before attempting a duplicate commit
CodeRabbit reviews plan files and migration files that are already executed/superseded — these should be marked 'not applicable' with explanation of the execution state
GitHub Actions SDK E2E failures surface DTO validation errors immediately when test fixtures aren't updated alongside API changes
Outside-diff review comments appear in the review body text, not as inline thread objects — must be fetched via review body, not reviewThreads GraphQL query

friction: Outside-diff critical comment (vault.rs init ordering) was not surfaced by the standard reviewThreads GraphQL query — required fetching the review body directly
Verifier agent wrote VERIFICATION.md to an unexpected path, requiring multiple bash spot-checks to locate the file
recovery.html has an inline duplicate of deserializeVaultBlobV2 that diverged from the canonical packages/core implementation — required a separate fix pass
CodeRabbit re-flagged the same useAuth.ts rootIpnsName concern across two separate review rounds despite being resolved as not-applicable the first time
SDK E2E tests were not updated as part of the gap closure plans — the CI failure was the first signal that test fixtures were out of sync with the simplified API
open_items: 2 items need live environment human verification: (1) new user init publishes v2 blob to IPFS before API registration, (2) recovery tool IPFS-direct path with a real vault and live IPFS gateway

recovery.html inline deserializeVaultBlobV2 is a maintenance hazard — it duplicates packages/core blob.ts logic and will diverge again on future blob format changes; consider importing from core or adding a shared build step
Next phase is Phase 23 — /gsd:discuss-phase 23 or /gsd:plan-phase 23 is the suggested next step
